subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should TUI delivery become a persistent config/default surface, or should it remain launch-only via `openclaw tui --deliver`?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally keep delivery fixed at launch, while the requested fix adds public config/default behavior under a repo policy that sets a high bar for new config keys.

options.title: Approve narrow config default
options.body: Add one canonical TUI delivery default key with CLI flag precedence, config-schema metadata, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Keep launch-only behavior
options.body: Document that delivery remains an explicit per-launch choice and close the config-default request as not planned.

options.title: Defer to broader TUI settings design
options.body: Leave this open until maintainers decide whether delivery belongs in config, a session setting, or a future TUI settings surface.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow config default
recommendation.body: Add one canonical TUI delivery default key with CLI flag precedence, config-schema metadata, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and continues to own much of the TUI/config/docs surface, and the remaining decision is product-level config direction rather than a narrow code fix.
